verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is agentic-payments infrastructure. A payments platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights from user data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents tokenization, passkey authentication, purchase-intent mandates, the Trusted Agent Protocol and an MCP/agent toolkit for invoices and payment links. Nothing shows the product generating insights or suggestions from a user's data. Commerce signals are described only as dispute-resolution evidence, not as insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
